decisions.reason: Using relevant images to fill empty page space does not change the selected body typeface or weight treatment.
The supplemental subject-matter images do not change author names, author photographs, or their presentation.
This source addresses excessive empty page space, while the candidate addresses breaking up excessive uninterrupted text; the candidate remains valid unchanged.
Adding images to balance affected article pages does not change the flipbook deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior.
Supplemental article images do not change which tribute page or articles must be included in the issue.
The source specifies a page-balancing treatment but does not change editorial ordering, placement rules, or the flat-plan basis.
The client specifically requests article-subject images rather than advertisements, and does not change the advertisement-rendering requirement.
Requesting additional relevant images does not modify the existing rule to enhance image quality when needed.
The article-page image additions do not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The source message contains a separate Heyzine branding decision already represented under this candidate, but the whitespace-balancing modification itself does not affect hosting or branding state.
The requested image count and subject relevance do not change the established visual style, branding reference, or red-color rule.
The one-hour fix window is consistent with the existing launch deadline and does not establish a new launch time or lifecycle change.
